summary: Feature 4 (Approved Partners admin tab) end-to-end frontend testing passed. Admin login works; left-nav renamed from 'Managers' to 'Approved Partners'; the tab renders DB-backed data (not mock) via GET /api/admin/managers; Tushar Research (INA000099887, firm 'Tushar Research LLP') is visible alongside Rakesh Research; per-row edit + Save (PUT /api/admin/managers/{id}) persists with 'Saved' toast; Active checkbox toggle-off hides partner on public /managers (card count went 2->1, Tushar's card gone), toggle-on restores it and /manager/{id} detail page loads with Tushar content; global Publish/Discard buttons are correctly hidden on this tab.
critical_code_review_comments: ApprovedPartnersAdmin useEffect uses empty deps with eslint-disable — acceptable, but if token prop changes on refresh it won't refetch. Minor.
AdminPage.jsx is 838 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting each tab (leads/listings/partners/database/faqs/settings/home) into its own component for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing pre-seeded 'Tushar Research' (id f35dc97a-aeee-4346-b0a7-ccdb0928118b) and 'Rakesh Research' approved partners.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Approved Partners admin tab is stable. testids: approved-partners-admin, partner-row-<id>, partner-save-<id>, partner-active-<id>. Public managers page uses manager-card-<id>. Feature 4 verified end-to-end.
